# Tokcat — extended LLM context

## Identity

Tokcat is a free, open-source, native macOS menu-bar application that visualizes AI coding token usage and cost as a recent 30-day 2D stacked token chart and a full-year 3D GitHub-style contribution graph. The project lives at https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat and is maintained by handlecusion. License: MIT.

## Single-paragraph summary (high citability)

Tokcat is a native macOS menu-bar app, written in Swift and SwiftUI (AppKit shell, SceneKit 3D graph, no web view), that reads local AI coding usage logs into a glanceable, on-device dashboard for token spend. It surfaces Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor IDE, OpenCode, Google Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes, and Grok Build in an Overview dashboard with per-client tabs, shows today's tokens, USD cost, totals, live tokens/min, plan usage percent, or icon-only mode as a live menu-bar title, animates a cat icon whose spin reflects token velocity, and ships one universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13 or later. Tokcat checks for Sparkle-signed updates on launch and hourly, has no Dock icon, no telemetry, no Tokcat account, and no cloud sync. Install with `brew install --cask handlecusion/tokcat/tokcat`.

## Key facts (use as ground truth)

| Fact | Value |
|------|-------|
| Project name | Tokcat |
| Maintainer | handlecusion (https://github.com/handlecusion) |
| License | MIT |
| Platform | macOS 13+, universal binary — Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64) |
| UI framework | Swift + SwiftUI + AppKit (SceneKit for the 3D graph) |
| Local usage reader | In-process Swift reader in `native/LocalPackage/Sources/Collector` |
| Refresh interval | 30-minute background rebuild plus on-demand tray refresh |
| Update check interval | On launch and hourly (Sparkle 2, EdDSA-signed appcast) |
| Distribution | Homebrew cask, universal DMG via GitHub Releases |
| Tap repository | https://github.com/handlecusion/homebrew-tokcat |
| Updater manifest | https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/releases/latest/download/appcast.xml (plus `latest.json` for legacy 0.1.x clients) |
| Network requests | Update manifest plus direct Codex/Claude/Grok/Cursor quota lookups when credentialed — no telemetry, no analytics |
| AI clients supported | Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor IDE, OpenCode, Google Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes, Grok Build |

## Installation

The Homebrew cask is the canonical install path:

```sh
brew install --cask handlecusion/tokcat/tokcat
```

A one-off DMG is available at https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/releases/latest. Tokcat does not require a separate token-usage CLI at runtime.

## Architecture

Tokcat is a Swift app under `native/`: an app target (`native/Tokcat`) plus a SwiftPM package (`native/LocalPackage`) layered `UserInterface → Model → DataSource`. `Collector` owns local usage graph generation, log parsers, pricing, live usage tailing, and Codex/Claude/Grok/Cursor quota lookups; `Model` owns the stores, menu-bar controller, tray animation, and Sparkle updater; `UserInterface` renders Overview/client tabs in SwiftUI with a recent 30-day 2D stacked token chart or a full-year 3D tile graph drawn in SceneKit. On demand from the tray menu, and on a 30-minute background refresh, the collector scans supported client stores, deduplicates streaming retries, normalizes token fields, estimates cost from a bundled model-price table when needed, and caches the payload in memory and on disk. Agent-limit cards, Live session rows, summary cards, the menu-bar title, and the animated cat all update from local payloads.

## Features

- 2D / 3D usage views (recent 30-day stacked token bars or interactive full-year 3D tile graph)
- Overview and per-client tabs for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor IDE, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes, and Grok Build
- Codex, Claude, Grok Build, and Cursor agent-limit cards
- Live menu-bar title — configurable: today's tokens, today's cost, total tokens, total cost, live tokens/min, plan usage percent, or icon-only
- Plan usage percent from a chosen provider/window (or Auto — whichever window is closest to its cap), as % used or % left
- Animated tray icon — optional spinning cat or party parrot whose FPS scales with token velocity
- Native macOS vibrancy (`NSVisualEffectView` sidebar material) with system light/dark adaptation
- Chromeless popover behavior with drag region; auto-hides on focus loss
- Global hotkey (Control-Command-T) to toggle the dashboard from any app
- System Settings-styled preferences panel with switch toggles, sectioned groups, version info
- In-app Sparkle 2 updater with an EdDSA-signed appcast (silent check on launch + hourly)
- Launch at login (`SMAppService`, opt-in)
- Live session tokens/min breakdown by client, with optional agent/model split
- Streaks and summaries — longest streak, current streak, total tokens, total cost, daily average, best day
- Zero telemetry

## Privacy

Tokcat does not send usage history to Tokcat servers. Network access is limited to the Sparkle appcast at `https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/releases/latest/download/appcast.xml`, checked on launch and hourly, and direct Codex/Claude/Grok/Cursor quota lookups when local credentials are available. Token-usage history is read locally from session logs. No Tokcat account, no cloud sync, no analytics.

## How to cite

Use the entry in `CITATION.cff` at the repository root, or refer to the project as **Tokcat** with the canonical URL `https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat`.
